audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows were wrong. win[2] and win[4] read Fiora while whys[2] and whys[4] both open with 'Skill'; win[3] and win[5] read Skill while whys[3] and whys[5] both say 'Fiora-favoured'; win[6] read Fiora while whys[6] says 'Yone-favoured'. The fiora__yone mirror flipped win[3] and win[5] to Fiora and win[6] to Yone, and the packet chart agrees on all five.
audit.why: The chart was, row for row, the opposite of the sentences printed under it.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Fiora / Skill / Fiora / Yone across both layers, with ratings swapped to match the flipped sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is the tracked ability on every screen with no cooldown given, and Grand Challenge is described only as 'R healing'.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s — a very long window, and the entire matchup is 'commit inside that window'. Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s, deals true damage, and heals her when she completes the vitals.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[1], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Riposte interaction is half-stated. The page says it 'parries + stuns your knockup', which is right, but never says the same is true of Fate Sealed: Riposte stuns whenever it blocks an immobilising effect, and Fate Sealed's pull is a displacement, so a 120-second ultimate cast into an up Riposte returns a stun on you. mid also says she can 'parry your ult mark', which is not what happens — there is no mark to parry.
audit.why: This is the single most expensive mistake available in the matchup and the page leaves it implicit.
audit.corrected: Written explicitly into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[0] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grand Challenge is true damage and Lunge applies on-hit effects; neither reaches the page, and the content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds against a champion who heals off her passive and her ultimate.
audit.why: Stacking armour reads the duel wrong twice over — her ult ignores it and her Q scales through items instead.
audit.corrected: True damage and the healing written into dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns; on-hit into wants.foe[1].

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Fiora must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online. Riposte is 24s at rank 1, and the gap after it is your only clean trade — hold the wave near you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riposte's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her level spike plus Riposte punishes any committed combo. Trade only in the window after she has spent it, and bank small leads.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Fiora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last target and pulls. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Grand Challenge changes the math.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riposte's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King helps, but her item spike and Grand Challenge healing still win duels.

edits.before: Fiora owns the early lane: her Riposte (W) parries your Q knock-up or a landed R and stuns you, so never commit a combo into an up W, and her Lunge (Q) pokes you between vitals.
edits.after: Fiora owns the early lane: Riposte (W, 24s at rank 1) parries your Q3 knock-up or Fate Sealed and stuns you for it, so never commit into an up W, and Lunge pokes you between vitals.

edits.before: Her passive vitals plus level-6 damage let her win extended trades; your R is risky because she can Riposte the mark, so use it only when her W is on cooldown.
edits.after: Her vitals plus level-6 damage win extended trades, and Grand Challenge (110s at rank 1) is true damage that heals her. Only commit Fate Sealed once Riposte is spent.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay in her favor — she out-duels you and can parry your ult mark, so avoid solo all-ins, use the Skill windows to CS safely, and don't feed her vital procs.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay in her favour — she out-duels you, and Riposte turns Fate Sealed's pull into a stun on you, so avoid solo all-ins and use the Skill windows to CS safely.

edits.before: Hit Lunge (Q) to proc vitals and win poke trades
edits.after: Hit Lunge to proc vitals and apply her on-hit items

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns your knockup. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riposte: 24s at rank 1 — it parries everything, and blocking a displacement stuns you, so neither Q3 nor Fate Sealed is safe into it. - Grand Challenge: 110s, true damage, heals her. - Lunge: 13s at rank 1.

edits.before: Parries + stuns your knockup. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 24s at rank 1 — it parries everything and stuns off any displacement.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her passive heals her every time she hits one — keep moving.

edits.before: E-ing in while his answer is up or overstaying the soul timer — the snap-back position is where Yones die.
edits.after: Grand Challenge is true damage and heals her off the fourth vital, so armour and MR will not save you.

notes: The chart was inverted against its own reasons in five of seven rows — the largest chart/why disagreement in my slice. I flipped ratings alongside the sides so a Fiora row does not render 5/10 while a Skill row renders 2/10; if the rating convention is something other than 'higher is better for Yone', those five rating edits can be dropped without touching the sides. Per the fiora__yone mirror I did not repeat the 'Fate Sealed knockup' phrasing in the strings I rewrote — it is a blink-behind plus a pull. That still counts as a displacement, so the Riposte warning holds either way, and I stated it that way.
